Portfolio.

Software systems designed and built across technical education, civic information, financial services, media, games and network engineering. Each record follows the same structure: problem statement, contribution, architecture, method and data, verification and limitations, followed by a guided tour of the actual screens.

N° 01Simulation-based IT training environment2026

Uplink IT Academy

A training environment for the transition from help-desk support to network engineering. It combines certification item banks, a simulated service desk and command-line laboratories, and each laboratory is checked automatically before it is published.

Live

N° 02Booking and operations platform for live commerce (proposal)2026

OCD Live

A proposal prepared for Bovann Group: an end-to-end booking system for 90-minute live-selling sessions on the House of Challenge TikTok account, in the Lomé studio or remotely from 17 countries, extended by a business toolkit, a supervised agent, an academy and a 318-page book.

Live demo; a proposal to Bovann Group, not an official service; example data, no real payments

N° 03Interactive economic explainer and speculative novel2026

GRAAL

A two-part work on the distributional consequences of automation: an explainer that models the circuit of wages, consumption and sales as labour is progressively replaced, followed by a novel set in 2383 that pursues one outcome of that model to its end.

Live in English and French; Book I published chapter by chapter, the novel in English first

N° 04Residential asset-management system with a contractor platform2026

Keystone

An information system for the life cycle of a dwelling: an inventory of building components with service lives and replacement costs, a ten-year capital plan, preventive maintenance, structured diagnosis and a platform for the contractors who carry out the work, with the illustrated book Inside Your House.

Live: Keystone Home, Keystone Pro and the book Inside Your House; Keystone Parts being finished

N° 05Static security analysis for AI-generated web applications2026

CYVAREN

A static analyser for web applications produced with AI coding tools. It parses the source without executing it, evaluates six security properties and reports each finding with its file, line, rationale, remediation and verification step.

Live; free during early access; AI assistance is optional and off until a workspace turns it on

N° 06Literary saga, essay and encyclopedia (French)2026

1884

A five-book saga in French, about 365,000 words long, on an invented regime set in the real Cameroon, from the 1884 treaty on the Wouri to a refounded social contract, opened by an illustrated essay on the African predicament and closed by an encyclopedia.

Live; free to read; in French

An independent civic reference for Cameroon. It matches the written positions of political parties against a voter questionnaire, publishes proclaimed election results with their sources, and maps institutional responsibilities from the region down to the subdivision.

N° 14Interactive laboratory on Cameroon’s Internet infrastructure2026

Lemon Connect Cameroon

An interactive laboratory on why Internet access in Cameroon is slow and costly. It models the path of a packet from a handset in Douala to a server, from radio access and power supply to the backbone, international transit and market structure, and every figure on screen is dated and sourced.

Live; an independent initiative of Lemon Network Solutions, with no affiliation to ART or MINPOSTEL; simulations are labelled as teaching models

A civic-education platform that separates four questions confused in Cameroonian political debate (a people’s history, the development of land, the legal status of a plot and citizenship) and examines each against the Constitution, the land texts of 1974 and 1976 and dated scholarship.
